name: codetogether
description: Help developers understand agent-generated code changes.

codetogether.provider.description: Model provider. OpenAI sends supplied code and conversation to the cloud API and may incur usage charges.

codetogether.openaiModel.description: OpenAI API model ID supporting Responses and structured outputs. Set the API key through CodeTogether: Settings, not in this setting.

codetogether.model.description: Ollama model name. Use an exact name from ollama list.

codetogether.thinking.description: Ollama only: enable thinking for models that support it. May improve reasoning but delay the visible answer. Models with mandatory thinking may ignore this setting.

codetogether.requireAllQuizQuestions.description: Optional strict commit approval stored in user settings: require every generated review quiz question to show understanding. When off, submitted quizzes may be approved with recorded gaps. Applies to new approvals.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
